findings.description: The missing-CA-bundle check now emits a warning instead of raising OSError, so a nonexistent cert_loc is allowed to continue into the TLS setup.
findings.rationale: Trigger: verify=True (default) with DEFAULT_CA_BUNDLE_PATH pointing to a file that does not exist on disk, such as a zipped install where certifi is no longer extracted. Mechanism: the code warns and proceeds with the nonexistent path instead of raising. Impact: the request fails later with a less clear error from the SSL/urllib3 layer, and the user sees only a warning first.
